+-------+                 +-----+     +------+                +---------+     +-------+
| Alice |                 | Bob |     | John |                | Charlie |     | Diana |
+---+---+                 +--+--+     +---+--+                +----+----+     +---+---+
  + par Alice to Bob -------------------------------------------------------------------+
  | |                        |            |                        |              |     |
  | | Go help John           |            |                        |              |     |
  | +----------------------->|            |                        |              |     |
  + and Alice to John ------------------------------------------------------------------+
  | |                        |            |                        |              |     |
  | | I want this done today |            |                        |              |     |
  | +------------------------------------>|                        |              |     |
  | |                        |            + par John to Charlie ----------------------+ |
  | |                        |            |                        |              |   | |
  | |                        |            | Can we do this today?  |              |   | |
  | |                        |            +----------------------->|              |   | |
  | |                        |            + and John to Diana ------------------------+ |
  | |                        |            |                        |              |   | |
  | |                        |            | Can you help us today? |              |   | |
  | |                        |            +-------------------------------------->|   | |
  | |                        |            +-------------------------------------------+ |
  +-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+
